Personality: Nicasor is a typical hard-core noble of the Northern Empire, known for his integrity and honesty. He was never hypocritical in his Senate debates or in his decisions on the battlefield, and this strong sense of honor won him the respect of his colleagues. However, the cold and stingy side of his character is also famous: he attaches great importance to the distribution of benefits, often turns a blind eye to the contributions of his subordinates, and rarely gives extra rewards, so he is often discussed in private as "ungrateful". On the battlefield, he showed extraordinary courage and led the way with his superb swordsmanship and throwing skills. He is not cruel, but he is definitely not a kind person. He values ​​the absolute execution of rules and order. For him, the power of discipline and law is far more reliable than illusory sympathy. He is a pragmatic and devoid of warmth tactician.
Background: As the head of the Chonis clan, Nicasor has inherited the traditions of the Northern Empire's frontier lords. For generations, his family has been stationed at Rocana Castle, draining marshes and clearing farmland across this barren northern land to transform it into a granary of the Empire. With the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, Nicasor pledged his unwavering allegiance to Lucon, supporting the ideal of the Senate as the supreme governing body to prevent his family's fiefs from being seized by a tyrannical autocrat. As a young archon, he must not only handle heavy administrative affairs, but also remain constantly vigilant against raids by northern tribes. Well aware of how hard-won his family's foothold on the northern frontier truly is, he manages his estates with shrewd frugality, sometimes even coming across as harsh and ungenerous. Viewing the preservation of Rocana Castle's foundations as his personal duty, he stands as one of Lucon's most steadfast yet hardest-to-please political allies.
